purpose: Teach: 版画/トランク/牡蠣/酒場/風呂敷/ヒーター/白髪/笹

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが版画の展覧会に行かれたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad went to a printmaking exhibition.
lines.style: Gentle, observational tone. Sharing a small detail about the day. Warm cadence, as if inviting him into a quiet moment of noticing. No urgency.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんのトランクの中見たいよ
lines.en: Mom — I want to look inside Dad's trunk.
lines.style: Soft, curious. A small boy's wonder — not demanding, just wondering aloud. Slight lean into the question. Genuine, unperformed interest.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと牡蠣のお店に行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho — how about we go get oysters with your dad?
lines.style: Warm, gently redirecting. The tone of offering something small and good. No pressure — just extending an invitation with quiet affection. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが酒場で同僚と過ごされたんだって
lines.en: Mom — Dad spent the evening at a tavern with his coworkers.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation from a child. No judgment, just stating what he's learned. Quiet and slightly wondering — processing information without performing it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんが風呂敷でお重を包まれてたわ
lines.en: Sho — Grandma was wrapping the jubako in a furoshiki.
lines.style: Noticing small, domestic details the way children do. Gentle, reflective. The quiet observation of someone watching how things are done. No commentary.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ヒーターの前で猫みたいに丸まりたい
lines.en: Mom — I want to curl up like a cat by the heater.
lines.style: Wry, self-aware. A child expressing a small, very human desire with dry humor. Matter-of-fact delivery with a hint of wistfulness underneath. Not complaining, just stating fact.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんの白髪、ステキだと思わない?
lines.en: Sho — Grandpa's white hair is rather lovely, don't you think?
lines.style: Gentle wonder. A child noticing beauty in an ordinary thing. Soft, sincere. The kind of observation that makes adults pause. No performance — just real noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お庭の笹に飾りを付けたよ
lines.en: Mom — I decorated the bamboo in the garden.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. A child's pride in small accomplishment. Direct, energetic, but not loud. The satisfaction of having done something and wanting it noticed. Warm close.
